conditions: FY2026E consensus growth path holds roughly as guided (revenue +2.24%, EBITDA ~CNY 30.5bn)

scenarios.source: valuation/07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §2 weighted triangulation (cross-checked at CNY 23.56 by §3 direct build, 0.5% gap)
scenarios.joint_probability_basis: This is one joint operating-and-valuation path: Haier must deliver roughly the consensus EBITDA while the market applies no further margin-erosion discount. The 40% probability is assigned to that combined outcome, not to either condition independently.

scenarios.label: bear_cyclical
conditions: Commodity-cost pressure, competitive intensity, and China property-cycle softness erase SG&A-driven margin gains posted since FY2021
EBIT margin reverts fully to the FY2021 5-year trough (5.91%)
scenarios.joint_probability_basis: The margin trough is the operating result of the same commodity-cost, competition, and China-demand pressures named in the first condition, not an independent draw. The 25% probability is assigned to that combined cyclical-trough path.

scenarios.label: bear_structural
conditions: Moat erosion continues without stabilizing (revenue growth cut to roughly half consensus)
EBIT margin fades to 5.00% by FY2030 (below the FY2021 trough)
Gross margin fades to 23.8%, capex pulled back, CCC deteriorates to +30.0d
scenarios.source: valuation/07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 Structural-reset bridge (reproducing 04_intrinsic-dcf.md §5 runoff scenario); 24-36 month horizon
scenarios.joint_probability_basis: Represents the tail case where the already-confirmed moat-erosion trend (460bp 5-yr gross-margin decline, 2 consecutive ROIC declines) continues rather than stabilizes — correlated with, not independent of, bear_cyclical.

rating_cap: Cross-module forensic mosaic (RF-EQ-001, RF-DISC-001, RF-DISC-002 across earnings and management-governance) caps ceiling at Starter Position Only; Watchlist chosen here is more conservative than that ceiling
variant_perception_summary: The valuation discount to peers is mostly, not fully, explained by fundamentals once quality-adjusted (residual +1.5%); it is an earnings-trajectory discount, not an ownership-driven value trap (no misaligned controlling owner found). A genuine but modest edge exists in a cross-module accounting-integrity mosaic (3 sub-threshold tags across 2 modules) that no single module flagged as material on its own.
what_everyone_knows: Haier trades at a 25-38% discount to Midea/Gree/Whirlpool on every reported multiple; margins trail both named Chinese peers; the China trade-in subsidy is fading and raw-material costs are rising; the last two reported quarters both missed consensus.
what_is_priced_in: Most of it — the peer-relative method finds the residual gap once quality-adjusted for margin and moat erosion shrinks to a modest +1.5% (CNY 22.08 fair value vs CNY 21.75 price).
what_market_may_be_missing: That the discount is an earnings-trajectory discount, not an ownership-governance discount (RF-OWN-004 tested and not fired); and a cross-module forensic mosaic (RF-EQ-001 + RF-DISC-001 + RF-DISC-002, spanning earnings and management-governance) that individually sub-threshold signals compound into a real, monitorable caution.
edge_proof: If the FY2026 annual report (~March 2027) shows Haier Group Finance Co. related-party borrowing continuing to climb past 37.7% of its RMB10,000mn cap AND the accrual-quality pattern (receivables/inventory outgrowing revenue/COGS) persists for a third year, the forensic-mosaic caution is confirmed. If borrowing utilization instead stabilizes or falls and the accrual pattern reverses, the caution is falsified.
killer_risk: The confirmed moat-erosion trend (460bp 5-year gross-margin decline, 2 consecutive ROIC declines) continues rather than stabilizes — the H1 2026 print (2026-08-27/28) is the first live test.
kill_criteria: A third consecutive earnings miss at the H1 2026 print (2026-08-27/28)

The ex-North-America >10% operating profit growth claim is never reconciled to a segment P&L, or is reconciled and found overstated
Related-party borrowing from Haier Group Finance Co. climbs further past 37.7% of its RMB10,000mn cap, or cash-parked-with-affiliate % rises above 57%
A GE Appliances goodwill impairment (25.3% of parent-company equity) is taken
Incremental ROIC stays negative for a second straight year (FY2026)
